messages:
chris: Heads up — deploy-bot just flagged eu1 p95 + error-rate spike for rollout -> might auto-revert in ~5m. Do we let it run or take manual action?
deploy-bot: ALERT: eu1 rollout detected p95 latency 320ms (+130ms baseline) and 2.6% 5xxs over 2m. Auto-revert scheduled in 5m unless acknowledged. See /deploybot status 6723456789
chris: Copy. If we suppress, need clear criteria for manual rollback. Any quick object-level checks?
sara: I think we should suppress and do manual. Criteria: sustained 3m p95 > 250ms OR >1.5% 5xxs on control slice for 3m. If hit, manual rollback to v3.9.2 for eu1 only.
alex: Agreed with scoped rollback. Note: two Dedicated EU customers are on the new version — coordinate with account teams if we pin them back.
maya: Can we do a staged rollback? rollback 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m windows, watch KV cache hit and cold-start errors. Staged reduces blast radius.
bryan: I'll draft a short customer note for the account team in case they get pings: one-liner + ETA.
chris: who can ACK to suppress auto? we need to stop the timer.
sara: I'll do it. Running: ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 6723456789 --reason "manual investigation; staged rollback plan" --until 2026-03-23T12:40:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: Auto-revert suppressed by sara until 2026-03-23T12:40:00Z. Suppression ID: sup-8f3a. Monitoring continues.
chris: thanks. Sara — if we hit the manual criteria, execute staged rollback and notify me + ops. Alex — please ping account reps for the two Dedicated customers (names: AcmeCorp, FinData) so they're forewarned.
sara: On it. Starting canary rollback now: 10% traffic -> 3.9.2. Exec command: ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region eu1 --version v3.9.2 --traffic 10% --staged --step-duration 600s```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Initiated staged rollback to v3.9.2 in eu1 at 2026-03-23T12:27:10Z. Step 1: 10% -> monitoring.
bryan: Customer note draft: "We observed elevated latency for a recent deployment in EU. We are rolling back the service in EU to restore normal performance. No action required from you; we expect finalization within ~20 minutes. — Support" Thoughts?
alex: Fine. I'll DM account reps now.
maya: Monitoring: after step 1 p95 fell from 320ms -> 180ms, 5xxs down to 0.4%. Looks promising. Proceed to 50%?
sara: Proceeding to 50% now: ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 50% --thread 6723456789```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Step advanced to 50% at 2026-03-23T12:31:35Z.
chris: Good. Ops, watch kvcache warming — old version has slightly different cache keys, but we should be fine with gradual ramp.
maya: kvcache miss spike transient, now back to baseline. No customer errors reported.
bryan: Sent customer note to AcmeCorp and FinData reps, they acknowledged.
sara: Finalizing to 100% now. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 100% --thread 6723456789```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Rollback to v3.9.2 completed to 100% in eu1 at 2026-03-23T12:36:42Z. Telemetry: p95 170ms, 5xx 0.2% (down from 2.6%).
chris: Excellent. Please pin eu1 to v3.9.2 for next 24h and add a rollout note in the release tickets. ```/deploybot pin-version --region eu1 --version v3.9.2 --duration 24h```
sara: Pinned. sup-8f3a release note: "eu1 rollback to v3.9.2 due to p95 latency regression in v3.10.0; staged rollback executed; monitoring OK."
bryan: I'll post final customer-facing blurb in #customer-notify and link to postmortem if needed.
maya: Quick check: no follow-on regressions, metrics stable.
chris: Thanks everyone. Quick retrospective tomorrow — include canary window timing and why auto thresholds didn't catch this earlier. :thumbsup:
